verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs claim users can 'set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want', which is a first-party background mail-handling capability. It also documents a Zapier connection and an API for workflow control. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no detail on what the rules can trigger, act on, or how autonomously they run. Missing for 10: documentation of rule triggers, conditions and actions; evidence the rules run unattended end-to-end; detailed API/Zapier trigger docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
